samples.xml_description:
<module id="serial2parallel">
    <description>Serial-Parallel Conversion Circuit</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="din_serial">Serial input data.</input>
        <input id="din_valid">Validity signal for input data.</input>
        <output id="dout_parallel" width_description="[7:0]">Parallel output data (8 bits wide).</output>
        <output id="dout_valid">Validity signal for the output data.</output>
    </ports>
    
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="cnt">Counter value to keep track of the number of serial input data bits received.</parameter>
        <parameter id="COUNTER_MAX">Maximum value of the counter (8).</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[3:0]">Counter register to keep track of the number of serial input data bits received.</reg>
        <reg id="dout_parallel" width_description="[7:0]">Parallel output data register (8 bits wide).</reg>
        <reg id="dout_valid">Validity signal for the output data.</reg>
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of clk
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 4'd0;
                dout_parallel <= 8'd0;
                dout_valid <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if (din_valid == 1'b1 && cnt < COUNTER_MAX) begin
                    // Shift the current parallel output left by one bit and insert new serial input bit
                    dout_parallel <= {dout_parallel[6:0], din_serial};
                    
                    // Increment the counter
                    cnt <= cnt + 4'd1;
                end
                
                // Check if all serial input data has been received
                if (cnt >= COUNTER_MAX) begin
                    dout_valid <= 1'b1;
                end else begin
                    dout_valid <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
</module>
